mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, real_name, role, phone, status, created_at FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT id, username, password, real_name, role, phone, status, created_at FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, username, password, real_name, role, phone, status, created_at FROM sys_user WHERE role = #{role} AND status = 1 ORDER BY id
SELECT id, username, password, real_name, role, phone, status, created_at FROM sys_user ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password, real_name, role, phone, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{role}, #{phone}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET password = #{password} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_user SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
